name: Abu al-Hasan al-Tihami
bio: Ali ibn Muhammad came from Tihama, the lowlands along the Red Sea. He travelled in Syria and Iraq and served as the preacher at Ramla. His elegy for a son who died young passes from public words of consolation to an intimate address to the boy. Ibn Khallikan relates that he entered Egypt in disguise carrying letters from Hassan ibn Mufarrij to the Banu Qurra. He was arrested and killed in the Dar al-Bunud prison in Cairo in 416 AH (1025 CE).
